authority: User-accepted Commerce v0.1 Design Talk closure. Existing D0032 structure/names retained; only explicit decisions recorded. Remaining narrow qualification, ownership and technical boundaries are not inferred. D0040 user-approved A–D handoff supersedes only the explicit lifecycle fields. D0042 closes only the explicitly named E/F/G and investment-confirmation lifecycle boundaries.
philosophy: 交换 → 价值发现 → 资本形成 → 时间与风险 → 发展投资 → 资产重组 → 商业信誉。Gold是重要媒介，不是设计终点。

ability_structure.shared_boundary: Design target, not mandatory schema for every future specialization.

description.zh_CN: 零散商人与经营活动在此稳定聚集，形成自发的商业共同体。
同业制度形成稳定职业共同体与商业人才体系。
商业组织发现不同领域的价值，并经营资本的时间与风险。
成熟商业组织配置发展资本、重组既有资产，以长期稳定经营积累信誉。

base_effects.mechanical_contract: Each working Commercial Hub specialist receives additional3Food+3Production at all ACTIVE levels1–4; no old Lv3 upgrade. Native yields remain separate.
base_effects.authority: Legacy COM-001 retained; user explicitly cancelled COM-003 support upgrade in freeze review.

abilities.mechanical_contract: Retain Commerce branch SHARED-001/002; district and each building tier +1Housing; each working Commerce specialist +2 base Merchant GPP with normal percent modifiers. Shared current building/pillage qualification applies.
contracts.capital_investment; stable/venture are two modes of ONE named ability.

current Commerce ACTIVE IV for effect gating

venture failure refund +0.5 percentage points per reputation point when ACTIVE IV

presentation_contract.existence: Current Identity + permanent Potential defines cumulative current institutions; ACTIVE only controls abilities. Historical State holds former institutions separately; no old ability revival.
presentation_contract.representation: Presentation-only entries in Commercial Hub UI, not engine Buildings; excluded ordinary building counts, HD tiers, Standardization, District Development and default infrastructure value.
presentation_contract.tooltips: RP introduction, own-stage named abilities, necessary current status; technical bits/carriers hidden.
presentation_contract.performance: Event-driven cached state and on-demand rendering. Preserve av2-runtime-b076.103; no periodic scans, per-frame audits or hover requests.

commercialization.capacity: One working Commerce specialist permits one distinct simultaneously commercialized domain; a domain cannot be duplicated by more specialists. No experience/working-duration/continuous-work mechanic.
commercialization.activation: Per-domain toggle, repeat same-turn changes allowed. Persist selected domains and actual activation ordinal/order independent of UI sort. Capacity reduction LIFO-SUSPENDS most recently selected entries, never deletes configuration; capacity recovery auto-resumes earliest selected first up to current capacity.
commercialization.local: Commerce city must have the corresponding local domain district. Shared_D0035 absolute D: max single-district min(10,sum current eligible ordinary Tier weights), no relative normalization, institution/carrier contribution or invented tier.
commercialization.source_pool: Self plus other own cities with at least one valid direct domestic Trade Route in EITHER direction between city and Commerce source. Distribution reachability alone does not create this direct-route qualification.
commercialization.selection: For each enabled domain select current strongest legal candidate domain value source. Do not debit source yields; realize additional commercial value as Gold, not copy S/P/C to recipient.
commercialization.deleted: No50/100 directional premium, two-way requirement, deep cooperation or historical partnership.

mapping.notes: X reads the corresponding source city current domain output; no yield-share conversion or legacy20% copy. Commercial Hub itself excluded. Military/Landscape/Community/Government/Diplomatic/other future domains unmapped in v0.1. Commercialization-created Gold must not feed commercialization again.
mapping.source_aggregation_boundary: Current domain output is the accepted wording. It is not automatically old TERMS-002 Actual or unrestricted city-total output; exact aggregation requires clarification if those differ at implementation.

commercialization.formula: Gold_domain_per_turn = 0.1 * D_local * X_highest_legal * (1 + 0.005 * R_effective). D<=10; reputation R in[0,40]. R_effective=R only while Commerce ACTIVE IV, otherwise0 for this multiplier; stored reputation is not erased by temporary ACTIVE loss. No additional cap/floor or universal share conversion authorized.
commercialization.design_intent: Discover commercial value in other social domains. Commercial capital itself is already handled by Capital Investment, so Commercial Hub/Commerce is not commercialized.

configuration_lifecycle.manual_close: Remove selected domain; preserve others relative order. Reopening creates newest activation.
configuration_lifecycle.governor_active: With Commerce Identity retained, preserve selected/order and pause effects when unqualified; on qualification recovery derive firstN by current specialist capacity and current eligibility.
configuration_lifecycle.identity_exit: Clear selected domains and activation order; later Commerce Identity requires new choices.
configuration_lifecycle.owner_change: Clear selected domains/order. Distinct from retained city history and Owner-independent Commerce Reputation; enabled new Owner chooses anew.
configuration_lifecycle.reload: Same Owner and Identity restores selection stack/order without requiring clicks; recompute effective entries using current Identity/ACTIVE/capacity/facts, never replay effective snapshot.
configuration_lifecycle.example: Research then Industry then Harbor selected: capacity3->1 suspends Harbor then Industry but retains stack;2 restores Industry;3 restores Harbor.

capital_investment.domain: Player selects one investment domain. D is source Commerce city local domain absolute infrastructure depth. S is the highest CURRENT specialization level1-4 for that domain among currently legal commercial-relationship/network candidates, not yield. C=1.25 if this domain is currently commercialized in this source, otherwise1.00. Profit rate r=0.01*D*S*C. Domain whitelist/local district hard qualification and S candidate/level/empty-pool semantics remain explicitly unresolved; do not import commercialization whitelist/pool or substitute yield. Lock the selected concrete S source city, not only numeric S, according to source_selection.

stable.name: 稳健投资
stable.rule: Return_safe=P*(1+r). Principal is returned separately; D/S/C act only on profit P*r.

venture.name: 风险投资
venture.failure: Return_failure=P*(0.50+0.005*R_effective); R_effective uses normal Commerce ACTIVE IV reputation effect gate. Refund ratio50% atR0,60% atR20,70% atR40; always0<refund<P.
venture.success: Return_success=P*(1+3*r): success PROFIT is3 times stable profit, not3 times principal-inclusive return.
venture.risk: p_base=min(0.80,0.40+0.01*D*S); D*S contributes percentage POINTS. C affects profit only, not probability. Actual probability including hidden protection cannot exceed0.80 and retains failure chance.

confirmation_order: Compute effective probability within success hard cap
Update hidden protection according to locked outcome immediately
Persist unique contract, concrete Commerce and S source cities/Owner relation, domain/P/D/S/C/r/mode/probability/outcome/maturity/settlement/quote state and protection state
capital_investment.protection: Per source city shared across domains. First unprotected contract uses current p_base. After a locked failure p_next=p_current+0.25*(0.80-p_current), repeated failures apply the same recurrence; any locked venture success clears protection and next contract starts from its current p_base. Leaving Commerce Identity clears protection. No negative luck penalty, cap0.80. How a new changed D/S/domain p_base combines with existing protection remains unresolved; no rebase/max/additive fallback invented.
capital_investment.protection_scope: Per Commerce source city. All venture investment domains of the same source share one hidden protection state; different source cities are independent. Not player-wide and not source-city x domain.
capital_investment.save_load: During investment UI hides outcome; maturity only reveals and settles locked outcome. Ordinary reload before maturity cannot reroll. No claim to prevent reloading before original confirmation.
capital_investment.quote: Gameplay computes one confirmation-revalidated snapshot of principal/term/fundamentals/r/probability/returns, locked contract and breakdown. UI displays it, not a second formula. Show expected total return E_total=p*Return_success+(1-p)*Return_failure and expected NET gain E_net=E_total-P, alongside deterministic safe total Return_safe and net P*r. The requested negative-EV warning applies to E_net<0 (principal-inclusive returns are positive); below-safe warning compares the same units. Negative expected gain does not prohibit choosing venture. Show investment domain, S source city name and level, D, principal, term and all safe/venture/probability/refund/expected-return fields.
capital_investment.principal: At EACH contract confirmation P=0.25*current remaining national treasury. Later confirmations read the already reduced treasury. Principal is locked until maturity; no fixed national parallel contract count cap.
capital_investment.duration: Initial standard-speed term10 turns. Other speeds must use a later normal speed-scaling contract; no unified Shared investment-term formula exists, so no new scaling/rounding formula is chosen here.
capital_investment.parallel: Same domain may have at most ONE unsettled Capital Investment contract. Scope of that domain exclusivity (national player or source city) is not specified by the handoff and remains a narrow decision; no separate nationwide total-count cap.
capital_investment.continuation: Confirmed capital contracts retain locked contents/outcome despite Governor departure, ACTIVE decline, Commerce Identity exit, later D/S changes or route/network changes. Lost current qualification only blocks new signing. Specific key-city Owner change is subject rupture under ownership_termination, not ordinary qualification loss.
capital_investment.quote_lock: Confirmation locks Commerce source city, domain, specific S source city, contemporaneous Owner relation, P/D/S/C/r, mode and venture success probability/rolled outcome, maturity turn, settlement state and quote/state version. Later D/S/C/reputation/route changes never reprice/reroll. Ordinary running-contract reload cannot reroll; no anti-load claim before initial confirmation.
capital_investment.source_selection: Among the separately defined legal candidates, choose highest S; tied highest S chooses city earliest attaining that level, then stable City ID/stable key if still tied. Persist specific source identity and attainment evidence so reload cannot randomize choice. This does not resolve legal candidate pool, ACTIVE vs Potential or empty-pool policy.
capital_investment.ownership_termination: If Commerce source city OR locked S source city changes Owner, immediately exceptionally terminate: no principal return, no normal maturity settlement, no venture failure refund, no trigger/change of hidden failure protection. Subject rupture is not a normal locked failure; no reversal of protection already updated at confirmation is authorized.

development_investment.qualification: Source must be Commerce ACTIVE IV at signing, pay Gold, and have a currently effective direct OUTGOING domestic Source->Target Trade Route. Choose an already existing eligible domain district in the target. Reverse-only does not qualify; target domain need not match target Identity.
development_investment.identity: Target domain need not match target current Specialization Identity.
development_investment.effect: Initial standard-speed10-turn contract grants+50% Production to eligible ordinary BUILDINGS in selected target domain only. Not district construction, Wonders, direct domain yield, base costs, Gold/Faith purchase price/permission, unlocks or instant completion. No required Industry template or prior completion elsewhere.
development_investment.route_interruption: Outgoing direct domestic Source->Target route qualifies at signing only; later interruption/expiry/removal cannot change locked term/effect. No current qualifying route means no new contract. Ordinary current-qualification continuation and key-city Owner termination are distinct.
development_investment.relationship: Independent cause/qualification from Industry Standardization. Both may apply to the same legal ordinary building; their Production percentages add (example30%+50%=80%, not1.3*1.5). Example30% is not a new Industry balance decision.
development_investment.economics: Standard-speed DeltaP=P_ref*0.50*10; initial purchase reference1Production approximately4Gold; Cost=0.75*4*DeltaP=15*P_ref Gold. About25% discount to referenced immediate purchase compensates delayed10-turn realization, signing route/domain constraints and utilization risk; no recurring fee or investment-pool resource.

reference_capacity.facts: Current population and currently legal workable plots only; ignore current citizen locks and yield focus. Exclude fixed building Food, domestic-route Food, Wonder Food and all other non-plot extra Food from plot-sustenance model. Extra actual Food may permit greater realized construction value and is not an exploit.
reference_capacity.low: P_low is reference Production under normal food/population support preference.
reference_capacity.high: P_high is maximum Production possible using plot Food alone without population starvation.
reference_capacity.algorithm: Implementation may select a solver consistent with these definitions. No transient current City Production substitute. Normal P_low reference objective and plot-only starvation-infeasible case remain narrow definition boundaries; no invented surplus target/fallback.

development_investment.parallel_capacity: Each currently WORKING source Commerce specialist grants1 parallel Development contract slot. Specialist loss never cancels existing contracts; new signing allowed only when current active contracts are below current capacity. Across ALL Commerce sources, at most1 active contract per target city+domain. Different domains in one target may coexist; no duplicate+50% for same target/domain.
development_investment.continuation: Confirmed development contracts continue to normal expiry despite source Governor/ACTIVE/Commerce Identity change, route loss, working-specialist or current capacity decline, or target Identity change while selected target district/building remains legal. Key-city Owner change exceptionally terminates under ownership_termination; illegal target disposition remains unresolved.
development_investment.ownership_termination: If Commerce source city OR Development target city changes Owner, immediately terminate: paid Gold not refunded; selected ordinary-building +50% Production stops immediately; occupied parallel slot released immediately. Never benefit new owner or transfer remaining term.

restructuring.unit: Commerce ACTIVE IV unlocks special Team. Initial standard-speed cost500Production; Production training ONLY. No Gold/Faith purchase, Great Merchant exchange/sacrifice/recruitment gift or instant acquisition.
restructuring.eligibility: Target city must have Current Identity and Potential>=2. Team binds one target city; no intercity capital transfer.
restructuring.liquidation: At target current specialty district execute 资产清算; snapshot P and permanently lose1Potential, reallocatable capital=P-1. Enter REALLOCATING, close old abilities and current source qualification; preserve history.
restructuring.configuration: Move same Team to a new legal specialty district of same target city, execute 资产配置 only after minimum full disruption turns and all valid conditions. New Identity established, Potential=P-1, ACTIVE recomputed under own normal rules; consume Team on successful configuration.

disruption.game_speed_scaling: Scale minimum5 full turns with game speed; exact scaling/quantization contract deferred, no formula invented.
disruption.food_total: Do not reduce total Food directly or change consumption, add starvation damage or remove population. Affect net surplus/growth, not total Food before maintenance.
disruption.end: Timer alone never restores city. Remain REALLOCATING and disrupted until successful configuration; team can move into position earlier.

restructuring.state: REALLOCATING is legal distinct transaction state, never NONE/virgin city/first-completion/Legacy Claim. Historical identity does not supply current ACTIVE or source qualification.
restructuring.limits: No nationwide/per-era/per-city hard usage cap. Cost=source production opportunity+permanent targetPotential loss+target disruption. No additional dynamic population/building/yield Gold fee.
restructuring.history: Former institutions remain independent presentation-only history; no old abilities revived. Per-profession Legacy decides permanent achievements. Research tradition pauses outside Research Identity, retained age resumes on return without catch-up; no inference for other professions.
restructuring.lost_team: Enemy defeat uses protected-unit safe withdrawal, similar Great Person/Tycoon/Investor behavior: return to a legal safe city rather than permanent normal combat death. No player delete-unit button. Technical retreat destination/implementation must be verified; no Claim/replacement fallback invented.
restructuring.conquest: If REALLOCATING target is acquired by another player BEFORE asset configuration: immediately destroy this restructuring state and unfinished asset ledger; clear old CURRENT Identity; city becomes no-specialization; dissolve this transaction-bound Team. Neither old nor new owner keeps a resumable partial transaction. Original player later reacquiring city follows existing first-acquisition/no-own-specialization-history AI-city snapshot/Claim split (Spec PROG-006-009), NOT old half-completed recapture. Does not authorize deleting every specialization permanent history; distinct Legacy follows its own authority. This explicit exception overrides normal inheritance/REALLOCATING-no-Claim only after transaction destruction.
restructuring.conquest_intent: Old assets were liquidated but new allocation not completed: chaos-time conquest destroys/takes remaining reallocatable capital, invalidating the plan.
restructuring.training_source_lifecycle: Completed Team remains independent original-Owner asset, survives training-source Governor/ACTIVE/Commerce Identity/Owner changes. Once a REALLOCATING transaction binds it, lifecycle follows transaction/target city; training source is provenance only. Source Owner change never terminates another target transaction. Target transfer invokes conquest termination. No automatic new-owner unit grant from source transfer.

professional_unit_protection.rule: Reallocation Team cannot be captured or converted to enemy Owner; hostile capture/destruction uses protective retreat/safe return.
professional_unit_protection.priority: Existing target REALLOCATING exceptional Owner-change termination/dissolution remains prior; training-source Owner change never grants the unit to the new Owner.
professional_unit_protection.technical_boundary: Native execution/legal safe-return destination remains technical investigation, not captured-unit ownership Gameplay TBD.

reputation.accumulation: First reaching permanent Commerce IV institution starts reputation age. Each complete standard-speed turn retaining Commerce Identity adds1R, capped40; no Gold purchase/project farming/extra credit-point resource.
reputation.effects: Normal Commerce ACTIVE IV required for CURRENT reputation effects: each point increases commercialization by0.5% multiplicatively through(1+0.005R), and venture-failure principal refund by0.5 percentage points from50%. R0/20/40 -> commercialization+0/10/20%; failure refund50/60/70%. No effect on safe profit, success3r, base probability, hidden-protection recurrence, Development or Restructuring.
reputation.restructuring: Do not infer reputation removes Potential-1 or disruption; no such reward authorized.
reputation.balance: Standard-speed+1 per complete Identity-retaining turn, cap40 and two0.5% coefficients are v0.1 initial balance, not final game-validated values. Other-speed accumulation/scaling is not chosen here.
reputation.legacy: C institutional relationship bound to continuing Commerce Identity, not city/civilization history or Owner asset. Governor departure/ACTIVE<IV/specialist changes retain R and continue normal Identity-based age; current effects still require Commerce ACTIVE IV. Owner change does not erase, partition or reset R; unsupported owner freezes use and does not run professional mechanics. Any enabled owner lawfully activating this continuing institution can use R. Leaving Commerce Identity immediately resets R0; later re-establishment starts0. Do not copy Research retained-age policy.

contracts.network: Network outside named ability count. Retain common Trade Center infrastructure; commercialization direct domestic qualification undirected, development direct outgoing directed. No old20% convergence or connected-kind support payload added.

ui.entry: Project list action entries are not ordinary Production Projects. Intercept before native production request to toggle/open panel; never enqueue→FinishProgress→restore queue.
ui.commercialization: One relevant/legal domain toggle, Dashboard fields ON/OFF, working specialists, capacity, localD, highest source, current value, breakdown, unavailable reason; no two-way potential best field. Distinguish selected/temporarily suspended/effective domains and preserved activation order; not all suspension is manual OFF.
ui.capital: One 资本投资 entry, one-layer panel: domain, mode, principal, term, stable return, venture probability/success/failure return, fundamentals, breakdown, confirm/cancel together. No wizard. Display actual venture expected total return and expected net gain with safe comparison; net<0 is marked预期亏损, below-safe may be flagged, but venture remains selectable. Display specific locked S source city name and S level alongside domain/D/principal/term/returns/probability/refund/Expected Return; numeric S alone is insufficient.
ui.development: One 发展投资 entry, one-layer target/domain/contract panel: targets, outgoing qualification, district state/D, cost/duration/bonus, contracts/capacity, confirm/cancel. Show plot-based P_low/P_high/P_ref and quoted cost/term; do not price from temporary citizen locks/focus.
ui.restructuring: Unit + map/district action; no Commerce project action-entry budget. No player delete button; protected retreat status and unfinished transaction ownership termination follow restructuring contract.
ui.data: On panel open acquire one combined quote/qualification snapshot; local selection uses cache, hover zero requests. Confirm one Action request with Gameplay revalidation. No periodic polling.

contracts.confirmed_contracts: D established contracts: ordinary Governor/ACTIVE/Identity/route/specialist-capacity changes never retroactively cancel. Key-city Owner change is subject rupture and immediate exceptional termination. Capital locks Commerce source + specific S source, loses principal without maturity/failure/pity settlement; Development locks Commerce source + target, no refund, immediately withdraws+50%/releases slot. Per-contract details above govern, not permanent-asset inheritance.
